notes.title: Warriors United - Update v4.0
notes.notes:
Hello Warriors!
I’ve just released a new update for Warriors United, bringing fresh features and improvements to make the game more enjoyable.


Here’s what’s new

Select/Tab Menu
I added explanations for attacks and combos.

New equipment and inventory menus (they’ll become useful in future updates).

A new page to view the entire map.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45231035/020311d65ac55254a320994bb1a4dcd514be46d9.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45231035/80ecf9fe6e01dfccd26e1bf51c5acc939351e617.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45231035/ae699241b7346d0e5bdd6d0796630a22411e8219.png"]
Enemy Lock-On System
I improved it with new visual and feedback effects, making it clearer and more pleasant to use.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45231035/8213c131ccd65b5d22dfdebf6f10b99b6dbd87fd.png"]
Engine Update
The game has been upgraded to Unity 6, which will allow me to bring even more possibilities in the next updates.


What’s next


I’m working on adding and reworking certain attacks to make gameplay smoother and more satisfying.

A brand-new Ultimate Attack will be introduced.

The combo system will be improved to allow more input variations (such as holding buttons, spamming, attack redirections, etc.), giving players more freedom in combat.



Thank you so much for your support and feedback. It really helps me shape the game. More content is on the way!

notes.title: Warriors United – Update v0.3.1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I just pushed a small update to Warriors United with a few fixes and improvements based on your feedback:

Staggered Enemies Fix
I fixed a bug where some enemies would stay flat on the ground indefinitely after being staggered. They should now recover properly and keep the fight going.

Mouse Input Mode Improvement
I’ve enhanced the way mouse input controls the camera to make it feel smoother and more comfortable overall. It should now be a better experience, especially in fast-paced combat.

Sensitivity & Camera Settings
You can now adjust mouse and joystick sensitivity, as well as camera smoothing, right from the settings menu. Hopefully, this helps you fine-tune the feel to your liking.

Thanks for all the support and feedback—I'm always listening and working to improve the game!

notes.title: Warriors United - Update v0.3
notes.notes:
Hey everyone !

It’s been a while since the last update, and I want to start by thanking you all for your patience. Over the past few months, I had to slow down development to focus on my studies and personal life. Taking that time allowed me to come back with a fresh perspective and renewed motivation !

Today, I’m excited to release a major update for Warriors United, focused on UI improvements and overall gameplay comfort. 

Here’s what’s new


 Complete UI overhaul – The entire interface has been redesigned to be cleaner, smoother, and more user-friendly.
 New SFX for menu navigation – Every action now comes with satisfying audio feedback to boost immersion.
 More customization options – Tune the game experience more precisely to your liking.
 Improved in-game UI comfort – Better readability, cleaner layout, and quicker access to essential info.
 Revamped mini-map – It’s now actually useful, with dynamic icons that adapt to the situation!
 Skill visuals reworked – Skill effects are now clearer and more impactful, making battles more readable and exciting.
 Visual and audio upgrades for resource gathering – Picking up items and healing now feels way more satisfying!


What’s next?

I’m currently working on improving combat attacks and adding gameplay customization options, so you’ll soon be able to fine-tune your fighting style to match your preferences. Progress is going well, and I’ll share more news on that soon!

Thank you again for all your support during this time — this is just the beginning of what’s planned for Warriors United !

See you in-game!

notes.title: Warriors United - Update v0.2.4
notes.notes:
Hey warriors ! Get ready for an update that will enhance your gameplay experience and bring more stability to Warriors United. 
Here are the following changes :

Animation Stuck Bug Fix – No more frustration during combat: the bug where the character would get stuck in animations, whether during attacks or after taking damage, has been resolved.

Solo Mode Pause – A pause feature has been added in solo mode, making your character invincible outside of combat for complete peace of mind.

Life System – A brand-new life system has been implemented, adding more challenge to every encounter.

Multiplayer Improvements – I have worked on the stability and reliability of multiplayer mode to ensure a smooth, uninterrupted experience. Enjoy an enhanced level of immersion during your online sessions.

Updated Hitmarkers – For more intuitive combat, the visual feedback when taking hits has been adjusted to better inform players of the impact of their actions.

Transparent Foliage – Trees will become transparent when the camera moves through them, allowing you to keep an unobstructed view of the action.

Danger Effects: Flashing Screen and Heartbeat Sound – Immerse yourself in heightened tension with new visual and auditory indicators signaling low health during combat.

Health Bar Animation – The health bar now features a dynamic animation when taking damage, providing more appealing visual feedback.

Don't forget to join the Discord community for updates on upcoming features for Warriors United!

notes.title: Warriors United Alpha Release – Join the Battle Now!
notes.notes:
Attention, guerriers !

Je suis très heureux d'annoncer que Warriors United a officiellement lancé sa version Alpha ! Plongez dans un monde de jeu multijoueur coopératif, de paysages en low-poly et de défis palpitants qui vous attendent, vous et votre équipe.

Ce que vous pouvez attendre de la version Alpha : 

 Partez pour des quêtes épiques en coopération avec vos amis.
 Engagez-vous dans des combats intenses contre des ennemis uniques.
 Explorez des environnements magnifiquement conçus en low-poly.
 Découvrez le jeu dans sa forme préliminaire et participez à son évolution.

Étant donné qu’il s’agit de la sortie Alpha, vos retours sont plus précieux que jamais. Vos observations et rapports m’aideront à améliorer et enrichir Warriors United.

Rejoignez la discussion : N'hésitez pas à participer aux discussions de notre communauté et à partager vos réflexions, expériences et tout bug que vous pourriez rencontrer. Votre contribution rend ce jeu plus fort !

Rejoignez le serveur Discord de la communauté pour participer à la conversation et vous connecter avec d'autres joueurs.

Regardez la bande-annonce de lancement pleine d'action !

Merci de faire partie de cette aventure excitante ! J'ai hâte de vous voir en jeu.
